edges.rationale: Evaluation criteria must be defined before scoring rubrics can be developed, as rubrics operationalize the criteria into unambiguous scoring guidelines.
The choice of evaluation methods depends on the specific criteria being evaluated; criteria definition precedes method selection.
Benchmarks are selected based on the evaluation criteria and capabilities to be assessed, requiring criteria to be defined first.
Generation capability metrics are chosen to measure specific evaluation criteria, so criteria must be defined before selecting relevant metrics.
Scoring rubrics define how outputs are judged, which can influence whether human/AI judges or automated methods are selected for evaluation.
